command.serveStatic: Open HTML with Built-in Static Server
config.defaultUrl: Default address when opening a page.
config.remBase: Base font size for converting between rem and px.
config.tailwind.scope.instance: Change only the className at the current JSX call site
config.tailwind.scope.source: Change where the classes come from (the component definition), which affects every place that uses it
config.tailwind.arbitraryValues: How to write back Tailwind values that aren't on the theme scale.
config.tailwind.arbitraryValues.allow: Write off-scale values as arbitrary-value classes (such as px-[13.5px])
config.tailwind.arbitraryValues.agent: Don't write arbitrary-value classes for off-scale values; hand them to the Agent
config.css.strategy: How semantic CSS changes are written back.
config.css.strategy.editRule: Edit the matching CSS rule directly
config.css.strategy.agent: Don't write back directly; hand the change to the Agent
config.vars.strategy: How CSS variable changes are written back.
config.vars.strategy.editDefinition: Edit where the variable is defined (@theme for Tailwind), so every place that uses it changes too
config.vars.strategy.agent: Don't write back directly; hand the change to the Agent
config.snap: Snap numbers to theme scales and CSS variables (hold Alt for exact values).
config.verifyTimeoutMs: How long to wait for hot reload after applying before checking the page against the preview (computed styles and text), in milliseconds. Changes that time out wait one more round in the background and are marked live if the hot reload arrives late.
